mapper.sql: target_id targetId, target_service_code targetServiceCode, discovery_service_name discoveryServiceName, channel, status, version, created_by createdBy, updated_by updatedBy, create_time createTime, update_time updateTime
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM t_gateway_target
ORDER BY target_service_code, target_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: r.route_id routeId, r.route_code routeCode, r.channel, r.http_method httpMethod, r.external_path_template externalPathTemplate, r.downstream_path_template downstreamPathTemplate, r.target_id targetId, t.target_service_code targetServiceCode, t.status targetStatus, r.security_profile_code securityProfileCode, r.authorization_mode authorizationMode, r.permission_id permissionId, p.permission_code permissionCode, r.required_scope_code requiredScopeCode, r.request_cookie_mode requestCookieMode, r.response_cookie_mode responseCookieMode, r.idempotency_mode idempotencyMode, r.body_limit_bytes bodyLimitBytes, r.body_receive_timeout_millis bodyReceiveTimeoutMillis, r.response_timeout_millis responseTimeoutMillis, r.status, r.version, r.created_by createdBy, r.updated_by updatedBy, r.create_time createTime, r.update_time updateTime
FROM t_gateway_route r JOIN t_gateway_target t ON t.target_id=r.target_id AND t.channel=r.channel LEFT JOIN t_permission p ON p.permission_id=r.permission_id
mapper.select: SELECT route_id routeId, route_code routeCode, target_id targetId, authorization_mode authorizationMode, permission_id permissionId, status, version FROM t_gateway_route WHERE route_code=#{code}
SELECT route_id routeId, header_name headerName, header_use headerUse FROM t_gateway_route_header WHERE route_id=#{routeId} ORDER BY header_use, header_name, route_header_id
SELECT route_id routeId, parameter_name parameterName FROM t_gateway_route_query_param WHERE route_id=#{routeId} ORDER BY parameter_name, route_query_param_id

SELECT route_id routeId, rule_type ruleType, dimension, capacity, refill_tokens refillTokens, refill_period_millis refillPeriodMillis, concurrency_limit concurrencyLimit FROM t_gateway_guard_rule WHERE route_id=#{routeId} ORDER BY rule_type, dimension, guard_rule_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_gateway_target SET discovery_service_name=#{row.discoveryServiceName},version=version+1, updated_by=#{actorId},update_time=#{now} WHERE target_id=#{row.targetId} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE t_gateway_route SET http_method=#{row.httpMethod},external_path_template=#{row.externalPathTemplate}, downstream_path_template=#{row.downstreamPathTemplate},target_id=#{row.targetId}, security_profile_code=#{row.securityProfileCode},authorization_mode=#{row.authorizationMode}, permission_id=#{row.permissionId},required_scope_code=#{row.requiredScopeCode}, request_cookie_mode=#{row.requestCookieMode},response_cookie_mode=#{row.responseCookieMode}, idempotency_mode=#{row.idempotencyMode},body_limit_bytes=#{row.bodyLimitBytes},body_receive_timeout_millis=#{row.bodyReceiveTimeoutMillis}, response_timeout_millis=#{row.responseTimeoutMillis},version=version+1,updated_by=#{actorId},update_time=#{now} WHERE route_id=#{row.routeId} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT permission_id permissionId,permission_code permissionCode,status='ACTIVE' active FROM t_permission WHERE permission_id=#{id} FOR SHARE
